description: Defines the UploadDataStream class for managing upload data streams, supporting chunked and non-chunked uploads, including initialization, reading, and state management.

classes.name: UploadDataStream
classes.description: Manages upload data streams, supporting both chunked and non-chunked uploads, with methods for initialization, reading, and state control.

methods.name: UploadDataStream
methods.description: Constructs an UploadDataStream object with specified chunked mode and identifier.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the upload stream, possibly asynchronously, returning status via callback.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns total size of the data stream.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Returns current read position in the stream.

methods.name: is_chunked
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is chunked.

methods.name: has_null_source
methods.description: Indicates if the stream has a null source.

methods.name: IsEOF
methods.description: Checks if all data has been consumed from the stream.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Cancels pending callbacks and resets the stream state.

methods.name: IsInMemory
methods.description: Checks if the upload data is entirely in memory.

methods.name: GetElementReaders
methods.description: Returns list of element readers owned by the stream.

methods.name: AllowHTTP1
methods.description: Indicates if fetch upload streaming over HTTP/1 is allowed.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Called when a read operation completes asynchronously.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Sets the total size of the upload data for non-chunked uploads.

methods.name: SetIsFinalChunk
methods.description: Marks the current chunk as the final one for chunked uploads.
